gloss: emotional attachment; deep feeling; personal investment

definitions.gloss: emotional attachment; deep feeling; personal investment
definitions.explanation: Strong personal feelings tied to a particular thing, place, or activity — often based on memories, history, or long involvement. Usually positive: caring deeply about something.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}には{思|おも}い{入|い}れがある。
examples.english: I have a strong attachment to this song.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}の{形見|かたみ}の{時計|とけい}に{深|ふか}い{思|おも}い{入|い}れがある。
examples.english: I have a deep attachment to my mother's keepsake watch.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{故郷|こきょう}に{特別|とくべつ}な{思|おも}い{入|い}れを{持|も}っているので、{毎年|まいとし}{帰|かえ}っている。
examples.english: He has a special attachment to his hometown, so he goes back every year.

notes:
Compound noun from {思|おも}い (thought, feeling) + {入|い}れ (putting in). Suggests that one has "put feelings into" something through time, memory, or effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{入|い}れがある: to feel attached to
- {思|おも}い{入|い}れが{深|ふか}い: to be deeply attached
- {特別|とくべつ}な{思|おも}い{入|い}れ: a special attachment
- {強|つよ}い{思|おも}い{入|い}れ: strong feelings about

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛着|あいちゃく}: attachment — similar but more about possessions one is fond of
- {思|おも}い{出|で}: memory — a remembered event, not the feeling toward it
- こだわり: particular fixation — about preferences or standards, not emotional history
